Summary

[Farming + Relaxed Entertainment + Traveling]

Fang Zhengyi traveled through time to the Dajing Dynasty and became a minor county magistrate.

He spent seven years building his own paradise, hoping to be a local emperor and live a carefree life.

In the 13th year of Jinghe, Emperor Dajing went on a private visit and accidentally entered Taoyuan County...

The emperor was shocked when he first entered the county!

There are all kinds of novel things, which are dazzling.

"What is a flush toilet? It's so convenient! Hey... you actually use paper...?"

"Is this mirror also like something from heaven?"

“And this…”

........

Not long after, the emperor and the prince visited Taoyuan County again.

See how the young magistrate manages the court, marries the princess, and reaches the pinnacle of power!

This is an imaginary historical view, drawing on the history of various dynasties. I hope you enjoy reading it.
